order-agent: After-sales agent with Claude and tool use. It looks up orders and tracking, but never cancels on its own: the server makes the decision.
log-sherlock: RAG-based diagnosis of ERP ↔ e-commerce integration logs: groups errors and suggests fixes citing the source. Work in progress.
gitHooks: Git hooks that write commit messages with AI (Gemini, Claude or Copilot) and review code.
fiscal-mind: RAG assistant over the Brazilian NF-e documentation that always cites the source or declines when it finds nothing. Informational, not tax advice.
interviewcoach: Preparation tool for technical job interviews that runs 100% offline, without your data ever leaving your computer.
doc-guard: Validation, formatting and generation of Brazilian CPF, CNPJ (including the 2026 alphanumeric format) and state registration numbers for all 27 states, in TypeScript.
brasil-kit: TypeScript SDK for Brazilian public APIs (ViaCEP, BrasilAPI, IBGE), with caching, retries and fallback between providers.
frete-wise: Multi-carrier shipping quote API with parallel requests, timeouts, circuit breaker and dimensional weight rules.
tensorflowjs-running-recommender: Academic project from my postgraduate program. A simple neural network trained in the browser with TensorFlow.js that recommends the ideal intensity for a running workout based on the runner's data.
promptlab: Offline prompt engineering workbench built on Chrome's built-in AI (Gemini Nano).
pagewhisperer: Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that adds a smart side panel to any web page. Using Gemini Nano, it provides structured summaries, key points and Q&A, all processed 100% locally and offline.
nota-vision: Extracts data from Brazilian receipts, NF-e invoices and other receipts from a photo or PDF, with validated JSON and per-field confidence.
nfe-lens: Parser and viewer for Brazilian NF-e (model 55) and NFC-e (model 65) invoices in TypeScript.
ncm-finder: Product classifier for NCM (Mercosur tariff codes) with semantic search, evaluated by top-1, top-5 and MRR.
movie-recommender: Full-stack movie recommender: a TensorFlow.js neural network trained in the browser with a SQLite backend.
mcp-brasil: TypeScript MCP server that exposes Brazilian public data (postal codes, CNPJ, CPF, banks, holidays) to LLMs.
horse-bridge: REST API in Delphi (Horse) with JWT, OpenAPI and integration tests, consumed by a React and TypeScript front end.
hook-yard: Webhook receiver with a queue, exponential retry, dead-letter queue and an observability dashboard.
delphi-twin: Migration of a Brazilian tax engine (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS/COFINS, DIFAL) from Delphi to TypeScript, keeping the same test suite.
danfe-print: Generates the DANFE PDF (NF-e 55 and NFC-e 65) from the authorized XML, with a VCL app and a command-line tool.
copy-seller: Marketplace title and description generator with Claude, with per-channel rules and LLM-as-judge evaluation.
codereview-ai: Offline code reviewer using Chrome's Gemini Nano (Prompt API). Proof of concept.
Estudos-JavaScript: Seven mini-projects in plain JavaScript, one per day, with a gallery to open in the browser. Study project.
Delphi_Thread: TThread example in Delphi VCL: a background task updates a TProgressBar without freezing the screen. Study project.
Delphi_RTTI: Persistence in Delphi with RTTI and custom attributes, removing repeated SQL from data entry screens. Study project.
Cursodevmedia: Two HTML, CSS and JavaScript exercises from a DevMedia course. Study project.
Bikecraft: Website for a custom bicycle brand (fictional), built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Study project.
order-pulse: Unified order dashboard for VTEX, Mercado Livre, Magento and Tray, with normalized statuses, KPIs, URL-based filters and an ERP integration failures screen with reprocessing. React, virtualized table and E2E tests.
pixel-pix: Generator and decoder for Brazilian PIX copy-and-paste payloads (BR Code/EMV) in TypeScript, with CRC16, CPF/CNPJ validation and a React UI that renders the QR code in the browser.
sheet-cat: CLI that turns product spreadsheets (CSV/XLSX) into an e-commerce-ready catalog (VTEX and others), with row-by-row validation of EAN, SKU and price and an error report before import.
semantic-shelf: Hybrid search for e-commerce catalogs: vector and full-text with RRF fusion, Portuguese query understanding and optional LLM rerank, measured with NDCG and MRR against traditional search.
pascal-brasil: Delphi/Free Pascal library with Brazilian utilities: CPF, alphanumeric CNPJ and state registration validation, masks, PIX copy-and-paste and postal code and CNPJ lookup. No dependencies, with automated tests.
